subject: Two men found guilty over Starmer-linked arson attacks
posts:
Two men convicted of arson attacks linked to PM Sir Keir Starmer's property. The attacks, orchestrated online, highlight the dangers of foreign interference and the difficulty in tracing perpetrators.
Evidence: arson attacks, linked to PM, perpetrators convicted
#UKPolitics #Crime

Two men have been found guilty of conspiring to carry out arson attacks on property and a car connected to Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer. The prosecution alleged they were recruited online by a Russian-speaking individual.
